text: {"lessons":["A small gain on Stock A felt satisfying, but I should judge trades by their future prospects, not just whether they are above my cost.","When my account fell sharply, doing nothing avoided impulsive trading, but I should still review each holding and my overall risk rather than let losses make me freeze.","These few periods show how much account value can fluctuate; past price moves do not predict what comes next, so I should stay diversified and make decisions based on current information."]}
